criterion: which type of entity the encyclopedia article describes

categories.name: Person
categories.definition: An individual human being, living or historical, often notable for their profession or achievements.

categories.name: Place
categories.definition: A geographical location, including natural features (e.g., mountains, rivers, lakes, valleys, craters) and settlements (e.g., villages, cities, regions, ruins).

categories.name: Organization
categories.definition: A formal group or institution, such as a company, school, university, record label, or government body.

categories.name: Animal Species
categories.definition: A specific species, genus, or family of animals.

categories.name: Plant Species
categories.definition: A specific species, genus, or family of plants.

categories.name: Building
categories.definition: A permanent, enclosed structure with a roof and walls, typically used for habitation, work, or public assembly.

categories.name: Ship
categories.definition: A large watercraft, including various types of naval vessels, ferries, and cargo ships.

categories.name: Vehicle
categories.definition: A means of transport, including land-based (e.g., cars, locomotives) and air-based (e.g., aircraft) conveyances.

categories.name: Publication
categories.definition: A regularly issued printed or digital work, such as a journal, magazine, newspaper, or manga.

categories.name: Book
categories.definition: A long written work, typically bound, including novels, non-fiction, short stories, and game accessories.

categories.name: Album
categories.definition: A collection of recorded music, such as a studio album, live album, EP, or compilation.

categories.name: Film
categories.definition: A motion picture, including movies, television films, and mini-series.

categories.name: Structure
categories.definition: A man-made construction that is not primarily a building, such as a bridge, dam, or monument.
